actions.action: Slide plant out of pot and check roots
Trim mushy/black roots back to healthy tissue if present
Repot in fresh well-draining cactus mix with perlite/bark in pot with drainage holes
Water thoroughly or soak pot 20-30 minutes then drain
Check top inch of soil and water when dry
Move to bright indirect light away from drafts and heating vents
Remove shriveled tan segments once new growth appears
Root a few healthy segments as backup cuttings in moist potting mix
Provide cool, dim-night schedule in fall/winter for blooming

reason: The answer identifies underwatering plus old compacted soil and recommends watering and repotting into fresh mix, which matches the fix the poster used, with nothing harmful.
